scope: Historical published-bundle E2B comparison, before the current standalone builder preparation policy; not a fresh benchmark of the current checkout.
notes: Artifact keys are labels and SHA-256 identities, not local filesystem references. Control binaries, TFLite files, large dumps, private graph authors, and private compiler provenance are not distributed.

commands.json preserves recorded flags and affinity, with executable/model/bundle/fixture/cache locations replaced by documented placeholders. It includes the original cold-cache host packed command and the later cache-warm command; metrics.json and requests.json use the cache-warm run.
The supplied per-prompt TSV files match the original fixture hashes; performance.tsv and correctness.tsv are in models/gemma4_e2b/fixtures/.
YNNPACK and the static-QAT controls retain the source activation contract; packed-dynamic XNNPACK changes only W4 prefill activation/FC lowering. Decode retains the static graph.
Harness -O1; setup-only generated builder optimization disabled; backend kernel libraries optimized. These are historical settings, not current split-builder settings.
Controls reuse preserved binaries/models; dependency revisions are not forced equal. Native short-prompt chunk settings are retained in commands.json.

TTFT excludes loading and preparation. The native runner includes KV allocation/reset within its prompt timer; YNNPACK and LiteRT reset preallocated state before prefix timing. This matters most for short prompts and large capacity.
Phone processes ran sequentially with cooldowns; clocks were not locked. Small differences are not a reliable universal ranking.
No task-quality evaluation; logit comparisons characterize numerical differences.
Flat kernel reports have trailing whitespace removed; sample counts, cycle shares, and symbols are unchanged. Original report byte hashes are retained separately.
